scope: Close the demonstrated DXF retained-string accounting gap for DRW_ImageDef::name (group 1) with focused ASCII/Binary parser and full OBJECTS controls.

sourceFinding.relationship: The derived IMAGEDEF name hides DRW_TableEntry::name; the base name counter cannot account the derived filename destination.
sourceFinding.resolution: Add a dedicated derived live-byte counter using the existing shared DRW_TableEntry retained-string lease.

implementation.accounting: Reserve replacement logical filename bytes before assignment; retain the previous value and charge on refusal; release the counter through reset before the base releases the shared lease.
implementation.copyMove: Implicit copy/assignment preserve the derived counter and shared base lease.
contractLimits: Logical parsed DXF string length only; not allocator capacity, RSS, or a total process-memory cap.
Public post-callback mutation, DWG string storage, and writer/projection copies remain outside this owner.
DRW_ImageDef public layout changed; downstream consumers must rebuild and binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

selectorCoverage: Generated direct parser streams cover ASCII and Binary DXF and replace an earlier filename with a 256-byte final value.
Exact-cap succeeds; one-byte-under refuses while preserving the prior filename and its retained-byte charge.
Copy construction and assignment preserve the lease after source reset; only the final reset releases the charge.

Generated full ASCII and Binary OBJECTS input refuses before IMAGEDEF callbacks at cap-minus-one with ResourceLimit/dxf-retained-byte-budget, then succeeds on a same-facade exact-cap retry through a following IMAGEDEF sentinel.
Binary input is generated in temporary storage and removed; no persistent fixture or CTest was added.
